sources.title: Project Gigabit network build contract - Cheshire
sources.evidence_kind: terminated contract and replacement award guidance
facts: Freedom Fibre is no longer delivering the original contract
Freedom Fibre received no public funding for that contract
Openreach call-off eight was awarded £37.5 million
Call-off eight targets around 18,500 hard-to-reach premises
limitations: Awarded scope is not current built or orderable service
Termination and replacement must remain distinct states

sources.title: Project Gigabit network build contract - West Herefordshire and Forest of Dean
sources.geography: West Herefordshire and Forest of Dean
facts: BDUK and FullFibre mutually agreed to terminate the original contract
BDUK reports work on alternative plans
In April 2026 West Herefordshire was added to Openreach call-off three
Call-off three covers other parts of Herefordshire
limitations: Alternative planning is not live service
The update does not prove parcel-level completion

sources.title: Switching provider
facts: The index lists a £28 million Virgin Media enforcement outcome dated 8 July 2026
The index lists switching guides updated 1 July 2026
The index lists new-contract guidance updated 26 June 2026
The One Touch Switch enforcement programme is marked updated 11 June 2026
limitations: Index metadata does not substitute for the underlying decisions
Switching guidance does not prove service availability

sources.title: Switching mobile, broadband or landline
sources.evidence_location: official HTML service-selection and process sections
facts: Mobile customers can use Text to Switch
Broadband and landline switching can use One Touch Switch
The new provider can arrange the broadband or landline switch
Separate guidance covers provider failure
limitations: Switching process is not address-level availability
Retail procedure and network eligibility remain separate

sources.title: Switching broadband provider
sources.evidence_location: official HTML process and charge sections
facts: The customer contacts the new provider to use One Touch Switch
The new provider arranges the switch
Early termination charges may apply within a minimum contract period
The switching request uses address and current-provider details
limitations: A switching request does not prove a new service is orderable
Contract charges and network eligibility require provider confirmation
